title: The reconcile-with-evidence surface (closing an UNKNOWN)
source: The P19 closure carry-forward (spec/dependency/P19-DEPENDENCY-GRAPH.json closure.carry_forward item 2); ADR-0013 (the decision record)
policy: Register only. No P20 implementation or acceptance is claimed by the graph. The reconcile act crosses the channel ONLY as an evidence submission over the host-recomputed pending set (ADR-0013 D1): the runtime verb stays the ONLY closer (no parallel engine); the pending derivation rides the runtime's own attemptIsUnresolved rule (D3); the source vocabulary stays the frozen two-kind set — the operator is the courier, not the source (D2); the evidence refs never echo as wire structure; the act's actor is pinned at the channel edge (OPERATOR_EVIDENCE_ACT / principal:operator); the runtime (627, the deliberate exception), the gate, mission-execution and the idempotency registrar are UNTOUCHED; the honest empty environment is the presented truth (nothing pending reconciliation on a healthy mission — the designed empty state); the golden path is fixture-proven only (the labeled test-tier fixtures + the scripted answering authority); web stays unbound (ADR-0010 D7); the §5 store stays disjoint (ADR-0011 D6).

work_orders.lane_scope: Source-backed gap matrix (spec/productization/P20-0-GAP-MATRIX-2026-10-27.md — 22 rows verified at 72a6dd7 by two Explore survey lanes) + ADR-0013 (D1 the two members with the runtime verb the only closer; D2 the courier-not-source vocabulary law; D3 the same-rule pending derivation; D4 the file-disjoint lanes; D5 web unbound; D6 the automatic feeds stay carried) + the canonical work orders + this graph + the current-state registration. Ordering decision recorded: the reconcile surface composes directly on P19's dispatch members and the P18 attempt projection; the provider execution lanes and live-provider evidence stay carried (credentials destroyed); the §5 store question and the protocol-plane bridge stay named questions.

Host lane: NEW shell/reconcile-contracts.ts + NEW shell/reconcile-members.ts (the pending READ + the evidence-submission ACT with the act-time pending-set recomputation, the edge evidence validation, the origin/principal pin, the typed refusals BEFORE any runtime call) + the payment-mission-contracts interface growth + the service spread + the shell index exports + the renderer mirror growth + the census/drift updates (the never-crosses list grows 'reconcile') + the host battery + the fixtures growth. UNTOUCHED: payment-dispatch-runtime.ts, authorization-gate.ts, mission-execution.ts, idempotency.ts.

App lane: the NEW pins file (paymentMissionsReconcilePins.ts — the 400-line law forces the split) + PaymentMissionsReconcileCard.tsx (the two-act evidence entry: direction + source + refs, disabled-until-valid) + the flow module + the detail-view integration beside the armed card + the barrel growth + the jsdom battery (the call-order law extended; the scan-clean law).

TL lane: the composition growth (the port gains the two members — the composed-port structural guard pattern) + the bridge battery (the honest empty truth; the golden path over the labeled fixtures: UNKNOWN dispatch → pending card → evidence submission → RECONCILED + the mission state side effects; the act-time refusal; the runtime typed refusals surfaced honestly; byte-identical detail re-reads).

closure_policy: P20 closes only when P20-A/B/C/D are all accepted on main with their batteries green at the tip and the honest carry-forward recorded. No live-tier claim is permitted: zero ACTIVE connections is the deployment fact; real UNKNOWNs are fixture-only; the reconcile golden path is proven only over clearly-labeled test-tier fixtures.
